title: Team Compass
subtitleAdmin: Launch team assessments and view safe group insights within the active HR group.
subtitleManager: View team dynamics within your management scope.
subtitleEmployee: Discover your natural style and how your role at work may differ from it.
disclaimer: Team Compass is a collaboration development aid, not a clinical or validated personality diagnosis.
thresholdHelp: Team results only appear after this many participants have completed the assessment.
failed: The action failed. Refresh the page and try again.
emptyCampaigns: There are no campaigns you may view yet.
emptyParticipations: You do not have a Team Compass invitation yet.
selectCampaign: Choose a campaign to view the team picture.
privacyThreshold: {remaining} more completions are needed. Group scores remain hidden until then.
privacyConsent: Names and individual points only appear with the employee's explicit consent.
aggregateAvailable: The anonymised team picture is available.
noNamedProfiles: No one shared a named profile. The aggregate team picture remains available.
balancedInsight: The team colours are close together. Use that breadth and make the required approach explicit for each situation.
focusedInsight: The group has a clear preferred colour. Deliberately invite a different perspective when making decisions.
assessmentIntro: Answer each statement twice: how you are naturally and how you behave in your current work role.
innerPrompt: This is how I am naturally
outerPrompt: This is how I behave in my current work role
reviewComplete: All forty statements have been answered.
shareOuter: Share my work role by name in the team picture
shareOuterHelp: Optional. Without consent your result only contributes anonymously.
shareInner: Also share my natural style by name
shareInnerHelp: Only possible when you also share your work role.
responseSaved: Your progress has been saved securely.
resultSubtitle: Your natural preference and work role, side by side without right or wrong.
shiftExplanation: The distance between your natural style and work role is {distance}. Use this as a prompt for reflection, not a judgement.
managementSubtitle: Manage campaigns list-first; opening and editing happens in a dialog.
confirmStart: Start this campaign? The target group will now be captured as a fixed participant list.
confirmClose: Close this campaign? Participants will no longer be able to respond.
strengthAction: You bring pace, clarity and decisiveness when a team needs to move.
strengthVision: You spot possibilities, connect ideas and engage people in a new direction.
strengthHarmony: You build trust, listen carefully and protect sustainable collaboration.
strengthLogic: You bring structure, facts and quality control to complex questions.
watchoutAction: Under time pressure, pace can become more important than support or nuance.
watchoutVision: Many new ideas can displace focus, completion or practical constraints.
watchoutHarmony: The wish to preserve calm can postpone a necessary disagreement.
watchoutLogic: Thorough analysis can slow progress when a good-enough decision is needed.
communicationAction: Be direct about the goal and decision space, and deliberately check support.
communicationVision: Make room for ideas and finish with clear choices, ownership and a next step.
communicationHarmony: Allow time for alignment and explicitly welcome honest disagreement.
communicationLogic: Share facts and criteria in advance, and agree when the analysis is sufficient.
